# timeline fixtures

- `docs-basic.mmd`, `docs-industrial.mmd`: examples from the Mermaid timeline
  documentation (https://mermaid.js.org/syntax/timeline.html), MIT licensed,
  © Knut Sveidqvist and contributors.
- `social-media-sections.mmd`: the mermaid-svg 0.7.0 sample
  (https://github.com/xmiksay/mermaid/tree/v0.7.0/samples), MIT licensed.
- `cjk-wrap.mmd`, `minimal.mmd`: written for this crate: CJK, wrapping,
  continuation lines, a period without events and `:` inside an event.
